lines.text: Many learners say: How many old are you?
How old! How old are you?

native.tip: Kita tanya “berapa umurmu?” dengan berapa. Di bahasa Inggris tidak ada how many di sini: cukup how old.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “How many old are you?” 😅 Tanya umur dengan how old, tanpa many: “How old are you?” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “How old”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “How old are you?” lalu tulis umurmu dengan I am. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We ask “berapa umurmu?” with berapa. English does not use how many here: just how old.
en.caption: Ever say this? “How many old are you?” 😅 Ask age with how old, no many: “How old are you?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
